name: Decline Close-Grip Bench To Skull Crusher
how_to:
Note: Perform the exercise according to the instructions, as the pressing portion is not depicted in the image.

Step 1: Set Up the Equipment
1. Adjust a decline bench to a moderate angle (around 15 to 30 degrees).
2. Secure your feet under the support pads for stability.
3. Choose an appropriate weight using an EZ curl bar or barbell.
Step 2: Starting Position
1. Lie back on the decline bench while holding the barbell with a close-grip (shoulder-width or slightly narrower).
2. Extend your arms fully, keeping the bar directly above your shoulders.
3. Engage your core and keep your elbows tucked to maintain control.
Step 3: Perform the Close-Grip Bench Press
1. Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
2. Press the bar back up to the starting position, focusing on triceps engagement.
Step 4: Transition into the Skull Crusher
1. Once at the top position of the press, shift into the skull crusher by bending your elbows and lowering the bar toward your forehead.
2. Keep your elbows stationary and avoid flaring them out.
3. Extend your arms back to the starting position and repeat the movement.
Step 5: Maintain Control and Repeat
1. Perform 8 to 12 reps per set, ensuring controlled movements.
2. Focus on triceps activation throughout the exercise.
